title: Context-aware onboarding lattice: adaptive inline help and doc-link tiles
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design and ship a set of adaptive inline help tiles and doc-link anchors (the 'lattice') that appear contextually across the Console and Runtime configuration screens. Unlike previous static help cards, this lattice adapts copy and density based on user proficiency, route (e.g., model selection vs. capacity settings), and signal from recent user actions. Deliverables: Figma screens for 6 contexts, interactive component spec, microcopy set, accessibility annotations, and handoff package for engineering.
goals: Reduce first-week errors for new accounts by providing targeted contextual guidance
Increase clicks from inline help to deeper docs by 25% for critical flows (model pinning, autoscale)
Provide low-friction discovery of feature flags and rollout settings without blocking advanced users
scope: Inline lattice tiles for: Project Overview, Model Catalog, Deployment Settings, Autoscale Rules, KV Cache settings, Rollout policy page
Three user states: Novice (expanded tips), Returning (compact prompts), Power (icons only with hover)
Support for i18n strings and text length variants
Instrumentation hooks for click events and dismissals
out_of_scope: Backend gating/feature-flag rollout orchestration (handled by ENG-6312)
deliverables: Figma file: lattice master components + six context pages
Component spec (ARIA states, keyboard interactions, animation timings)
Microcopy spreadsheet with i18n keys and character limits
Handoff bundle with assets for screenshots and SVG icons
Acceptance criteria checklist and analytics events mapping
acceptance_criteria: Figma screens approved by PM and Eng (sign-offs in comments)
React component props and states documented (collapsed/expanded/dismissed)
Copy approved by UX writing and localized for en/es/fr de (placeholder translations)
Analytics events instrumented: help_impression, help_click_doc, help_dismiss, help_cta_followup
A11y: keyboard focusable, contrast ratios >= 4.5:1, screen reader labels present
implementation_notes: Prefer CSS transform for subtle slide-in (60ms) + reduced-motion media query support
Tile copy should be passed as structured i18n keys, not raw strings
Provide an API hook for product to set user proficiency tier (novice/returning/power)
Design system tokens: use token --ui-bg-elev-1 and --brand-accent-600 for CTAs
Fallback behavior: if docs unreachable, CTA should trigger in-app modal with cached summary
analytics_and_metrics: Primary metric: help_click_doc rate (target +25% in first 8 weeks)
Tertiary: task completion delta for onboarding flows (measure via conversion funnel)
accessibility_notes: All tiles must be reachable via Tab and announced by screen readers as 'Help tip: <title>'
Provide aria-expanded on collapsible tiles, aria-describedby for longer tips
Ensure icons use decorative role if label is present, otherwise include accessible name
Test with VoiceOver and NVDA for common flows
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Internal dogfood across two product squads (Console + Runtime) for 2 weeks
Phase 2: Beta with 50 external accounts, gated by feature flag
Phase 3: Gradual ramp to 100% with telemetry checks and rollback condition if help_click_doc decreases
